full_prompt_en: This is a square, sepia-gray graphite drawing of a human head in close side profile on aged cream paper. The face turns toward the left, with a heavy brow, sharply observed eye, long nose, closed mouth, and strong chin occupying most of the left and middle of the frame. The forehead and cheek are smoothly shaded with fine pencil hatching, while the rear of the head dissolves into branching, wirelike and bone-like forms. Thin straight construction lines cross the image vertically and horizontally, forming a measured grid around the face. Fainter circles, arcs, and lightly sketched fragments extend behind the cheek and temple, as if the portrait is being analyzed and reassembled on the page. Near the lower left, a few loose pencil strokes and faint notation-like marks remain too indistinct to read. The paper shows small stains, scratches, and uneven warm discoloration, giving the drawing an archival quality. Soft light appears even across the sheet; depth comes from graphite value, especially the dark eye socket, nose underside, and the branching recesses near the ear. The farthest technical lines stay pale, while the face's main contour is dark and decisive. No fully rendered room surrounds the head. The composition is cropped tightly, so the face feels monumental despite the delicate lines. The overall image is analytical and uncanny, joining precise portrait observation with fragile geometric scaffolding and weathered paper texture.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、灰褐色石墨绘画，一张人的头部以贴近的侧面呈现在旧奶油色纸上。面部朝左，沉重眉骨、仔细观察的眼睛、长鼻子、闭合的嘴与有力下巴占据左侧和中部大部分区域。额头与脸颊由细铅笔排线平顺塑形，后脑却化入分枝的金属丝状与骨状形体。细直构图线纵横穿过图像，在面孔周围形成经过测量的网格。更淡的圆、弧线和轻描碎片伸向脸颊与太阳穴后方，仿佛肖像正在纸上被分析和重新拼合。左下附近有几笔松散铅笔线和淡淡记号状痕迹，模糊到无法辨读。纸面有小污渍、刮痕和不均匀暖色变色，使素描具有档案气息。整张纸仿佛受均匀柔光照亮；纵深来自石墨明度，尤其是深色眼窝、鼻下和耳旁分枝凹处。最远的技术线保持浅淡，面部主要轮廓则深而明确。头部周围没有完整绘制的房间。取景紧凑，使脸在细线之中仍显宏大。整体图像富于分析感且怪异，将精确肖像观察与脆弱几何脚手架、磨旧纸张肌理结合。
style_prompt_en: The graphite-and-paper treatment layers precise tonal modeling with translucent construction marks. Aged cream, warm gray, and deep charcoal make a restrained near-monochrome field. Dark focal contours coexist with pale grids, arcs, and branching fine lines that extend beyond the main mass. Smooth shaded planes contrast with scratchier, more diagrammatic passages. Even light reveals paper stains and rubbed graphite rather than producing cast shadows. Depth is strongest where hatching gathers in tight recesses; peripheral marks remain airy and provisional. The composition uses close cropping and measured alignment to make a small area feel monumental. The overall effect is analytical, delicate, and uncanny, as if careful observation and speculative reconstruction occupy the same surface.
style_prompt_zh: 这种石墨与纸张处理将精确明度塑形叠在透明构图痕上。旧奶油、暖灰与深炭构成克制的近单色画域。深色焦点轮廓与浅网格、弧线和伸出主体的分枝细线并存。平顺阴影平面与更刮擦、更像图解的部分形成对比。均匀光揭示纸面污渍与擦磨石墨，而非制造投影。排线聚在狭窄凹处时纵深最强；外围痕迹保持通透和暂定感。构图以紧凑裁切和测量般的对齐使小块区域显得宏大。整体效果富于分析性、纤细而怪异，仿佛仔细观察与推测性重组占据同一表面。
theme_en: A graphite profile study with geometric construction lines and branching internal forms
theme_zh: 一幅石墨侧面研究，叠有几何构图线与分枝内部形态
name: Hans Bellmer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
